scope: Eleven grid performance/profile/protocol/docs files; independent source review plus mocked CPU-only launch/setup failure regression. No GUI or real process launched.

finding.description: Popen and selector setup precede cleanup/terminal-record guard. A selector setup OSError after successful launch does not retire child; launch failure leaves no per-run result.json.

regression.classification: Demonstrated product process-ownership/failure-evidence gap under mocked launch/selector OSError, not a compiler/fixture failure.

provisional_other_contracts: Actual clip-count workload >=400 cells,50rows,8columns; paired layouts normalized and exact scale/cardinality checked.
Same native ticket generation/rawphase values and total work sum required; nonnegative integer phases and monotonic generation/frame.
Nearest-rank percentiles preserve outliers and per-run distributions; no independent percentile sum or full P6 completion claim.
Optional profile uses new O_EXCL0600 path,64MiB sticky-error writer, process-wide diagnostic labels and ordinary budget-run refusal.
Normal timed-out/invalid-output runs retire owned process groups and preserve raw output; setup boundary correction is pending.
